list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "host", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes", start: -7d)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "uptime")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> reduce(identity: {online: 0, offline: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      online: accumulator.online + (if int(v: r._time) < int(v: now()) - 90000000000 then 0 else 1),
      offline: accumulator.offline + (if int(v: r._time) < int(v: now()) - 90000000000 then 1 else 0)}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "qemu" and r._field == "status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nodename =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> reduce(identity: {running: 0, stopped: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      running: accumulator.running + (if r._value == "running" and not (int(v: r._time) < int(v: now()) - 90000000000) then 1 else 0),
      stopped: accumulator.stopped + (if r._value == "running" and not (int(v: r._time) < int(v: now()) - 90000000000) then 0 else 1)}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "lxc" and r._field == "status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nodename =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> reduce(identity: {running: 0, stopped: 0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      running: accumulator.running + (if r._value == "running" and not (int(v: r._time) < int(v: now()) - 90000000000) then 1 else 0),
      stopped: accumulator.stopped + (if r._value == "running" and not (int(v: r._time) < int(v: now()) - 90000000000) then 0 else 1)}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and (r._field == "cpu" or r._field == "cpus"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> reduce(identity: {used: 0.0, total: 0.0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({used: accumulator.used + r.cpu * r.cpus, total: accumulator.total + r.cpus}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: if r.total > 0.0 then r.used / r.total else 0.0}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and (r._field == "memused" or r._field == "memtotal"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> reduce(identity: {used: 0.0, total: 0.0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({used: accumulator.used + r.memused, total: accumulator.total + r.memtotal}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: if r.total > 0.0 then r.used / r.total else 0.0}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and (r._field == "used" or r._field == "total" or r._field == "avail" or r._field == "shared"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nodename =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["nodename", "host", "type"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.total and r.total > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({storage: if r.shared == 1.0 then r.host else r.nodename + " / " + r.host, type: r.type, used: r.used, total: r.total, avail: r.avail, _value: r.used / r.total}))
  |> unique(column: "storage")
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r._value, storage: r.storage}))
  |> group(columns: ["storage"])

data = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.object == "nodes")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      (r._measurement == "cpustat" and (r._field == "cpu" or r._field == "cpus" or r._field == "avg1")) or
      (r._measurement == "memory" and (r._field == "memused" or r._field == "memtotal" or r._field == "swapused" or r._field == "swaptotal")) or
      (r._measurement == "blockstat" and (r._field == "used" or r._field == "blocks")) or
      (r._measurement == "system" and r._field == "uptime"))
  |> last()
  |> toFloat()
  |> group()
online = data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "uptime")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "online", _value: if int(v: r._time) < int(v: now()) - 90000000000 then 0.0 else 1.0}))
union(tables: [data, online])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      node: r.host,
      online: r.online,
      cpu: r.cpu,
      cpus: r.cpus,
      load: r.avg1,
      ram: if r.memtotal > 0.0 then r.memused / r.memtotal else 0.0,
      ram_total: r.memtotal,
      swap: if r.swaptotal > 0.0 then r.swapused / r.swaptotal else 0.0,
      rootfs: if r.blocks > 0.0 then r.used / r.blocks else 0.0,
      uptime: if r.online > 0.0 then r.uptime else 0.0}))
  |> sort(columns: ["node"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, node: r.host}))
  |> group(columns: ["node"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and r.object == "nodes" and (r._field == "memused" or r._field == "memtotal"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if r.memtotal > 0.0 then r.memused / r.memtotal else 0.0, node: r.host}))
  |> group(columns: ["node"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nics" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "receive")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.instance =~ /^(eth|en|nic|wl|ib)/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["host", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value * 8.0, node: r.host}))
  |> group(columns: ["node"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nics" and r.object == "nodes" and r._field == "transmit")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.host =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.instance =~ /^(eth|en|nic|wl|ib)/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["host", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value * 8.0, node: r.host}))
  |> group(columns: ["node"])

panels.title: Toutes les VM et tous les conteneurs
panels.description: Cliquez sur un nom pour ouvrir son détail. « Sans nouvelles » : plus de mesure depuis 90 secondes (nœud éteint ou invité supprimé).

targets.query:
base = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nodename =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
st = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "status")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if int(v: r._time) < int(v: now()) - 90000000000 then 2.0 else if r._value == "running" then 1.0 else 0.0}))
num = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cpu" or r._field == "cpus" or r._field == "mem" or r._field == "maxmem" or r._field == "disk" or r._field == "maxdisk" or r._field == "uptime")
  |> last()
  |> toFloat()
  |> group()
union(tables: [st, num])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["object", "vmid", "nodename", "host"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      state: r.status,
      type: if r.object == "qemu" then "VM" else "CT",
      id: int(v: r.vmid),
      name: r.host,
      node: r.nodename,
      cpu: r.cpu,
      cpus: r.cpus,
      ram: if r.maxmem > 0.0 then r.mem / r.maxmem else 0.0,
      ram_used: r.mem,
      ram_max: r.maxmem,
      disk: if r.object == "lxc" and r.maxdisk > 0.0 then r.disk / r.maxdisk else -1.0,
      disk_max: r.maxdisk,
      uptime: if r.status == 1.0 then r.uptime else 0.0}))
  |> sort(columns: ["id"])

panels.title: Les plus chargés (processeur)
panels.description: Moyenne des 5 dernières minutes, en % des cœurs donnés à chaque invité.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r._field == "cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nodename =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> mean()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({guest: r.vmid + " " + (if exists r.host then r.host else ""), _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 10)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r._field == "mem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nodename =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({guest: r.vmid + " " + (if exists r.host then r.host else ""), _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 10)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and (r._field == "used" or r._field == "total" or r._field == "avail" or r._field == "shared"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nodename =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["nodename", "host", "type"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.total and r.total > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({storage: if r.shared == 1.0 then r.host else r.nodename + " / " + r.host, type: r.type, used: r.used, total: r.total, avail: r.avail, _value: r.used / r.total}))
  |> unique(column: "storage")
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({storage: r.storage, _value: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and (r._field == "used" or r._field == "total" or r._field == "avail" or r._field == "shared"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nodename =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["nodename", "host", "type"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.total and r.total > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({storage: if r.shared == 1.0 then r.host else r.nodename + " / " + r.host, type: r.type, used: r.used, total: r.total, avail: r.avail, _value: r.used / r.total}))
  |> unique(column: "storage")
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({storage: r.storage, type: r.type, used: r.used, avail: r.avail, total: r.total, pct: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "storages" and (r._field == "used" or r._field == "total"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.nodename =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["nodename", "host"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.total and r.total > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.used / r.total, storage: r.nodename + " / " + r.host}))
  |> group(columns: ["storage"])
